authority_review.scope: bounded 2023 natural lifecycle and visual review

clock.input: completed bars from the primitive timeframe
clock.synthetic: advances cutoff only; semantic state, reference price, event clock and age remain real-completed-bar only
clock.boundary: contract changes and unknown data gaps terminate pending BOS then reset state
clock.failed_pair_update: discard the terminal observer and resume from the last checkpoint
clock.exact_retry: same clock plus same completed-bar provenance is idempotent
clock.cold_event_memory: a persistent prefix start rejects every current or later event whose age or duration origin is not covered

swing.break_rule: a later same-timeframe completed close strictly beyond the confirmed swing

structure.identity: direction plus the first aligned confirmed-swing clock; frozen through its lifecycle

bos.confirmation: a later same-timeframe completed close strictly beyond an already-confirmed target swing
bos.scope: opposed only when target_swing_id equals the opposite confirmed structure protected_swing_id; continuation only when target_swing_id equals the same confirmed structure latest high for long or latest low for short; otherwise local
bos.break_evidence: freeze break_bar_id and unclipped close distance beyond target divided by causal ATR
bos.post_break_acceptance: the first later real completed same-timeframe close strictly remaining beyond the target is accepted; equality or a close back inside is rejected
bos.mss: the structure reducer leaves MSS false and displacement identity null; the integrated observer may qualify an opposed BOS only when a same-direction active displacement admits the same completed break bar
bos.identity: one BOS identity represents one pending attempt and is terminal after confirmed or failed
bos.same_target_rearm: a later confirmed-evidence refresh may create a new pending generation for the same target; pending_at is the refresh completed-bar clock and the terminal identity is never reused
bos.wick_only: records an attempt and never confirms BOS

support_resistance.frozen_tolerance: max(1 tick, 0.10 strictly-prior causal ATR at source confirmation); the confirming bar never widens its own zone
support_resistance.source_identity: structural swing zones retain real member_swing_ids; previous session/day/week zones retain one real source_id; mature range-boundary liquidity reuses its frozen source S/R through range_id plus source_zone_id and never manufactures a swing identity
support_resistance.reference_projection: each previous completed session/day/week exact high or low remains a point liquidity item and also owns a distinct 1m reaction band with shared source identity
support_resistance.independent_lifecycle: wick crossing may consume exact liquidity while S/R remains active/tested; only a completed close beyond the frozen S/R outer edge breaks the zone
support_resistance.reference_contacts: a later completed 1m bar entering the frozen band starts one contact episode; consecutive bars remaining inside do not inflate touch count
support_resistance.reference_admission: a completed-period source is admitted only on the first real 1m candle after its source confirmation; its strictly-prior ATR must already be frozen and a repeated source identity cannot rewrite price, side or clocks
support_resistance.reference_replacement: a source absent from the current completed-period inventory is retired before the replacement bar price is applied, so replacement cannot fabricate a test, break or reacceptance of the old zone
support_resistance.range_boundary_reuse: valid mature range geometry equals its two frozen source S/R distal edges, so range-boundary liquidity is LOCATED_AT the source S/R without duplicating a zone
support_resistance.touch_history: the first two formation/test touches plus newest bounded history are retained while tested_at and total_touch_count remain exact
support_resistance.source_metadata: source_kind, timeframe, internal/external structural_rank, protected-swing flag and reaction/liquidity/both zone role remain separate from lifecycle
support_resistance.quality_decomposition: visibility_strength describes structural visibility; reaction_quality describes causal observed reactions; freshness and depletion_risk describe age and repeated use; legacy strength remains compatibility-only

equal_liquidity.formation: two confirmed same-side swings inside one frozen active/tested zone
equal_liquidity.geometry: matching uses the frozen S/R tolerance, while pool lower/upper and sweep boundary freeze the first two actual member prices; later members never expand the pool
equal_liquidity.touch_history: formation touches plus newest bounded history are retained while total_touch_count remains exact
equal_liquidity.generation: after terminal resolution, two later confirmed swings are required for a new pool identity

inventory.projection: each real completed 1m bar independently consumes a visible swing, reference level or pool on strict wick crossing without rewriting structure close-break state or the source timeframe cutoff
inventory.authority: explicit top-level inventory remains authoritative when empty; top-level pool states hold current lifecycle and event memory holds ordered transitions
inventory.reference_periods: session is the 18:00 ET Globex trade date, day is ET civil date, and week is the ISO week of the session label; only the immediately previous completed period is materialized and it never repaints
inventory.late_attach: reconstruct every swing, reference level or pool first crossing and each pool resolution from the retained completed-1m prefix; fail closed on missing history or any partially applied multi-draw projection
